name: Spark USDC Vault
oneLiner: sparkUSDC is Spark's Morpho USDC lending-vault share, redeemable at its accruing asset NAV subject to market liquidity.

mechanismArchetypeReview.rationale: Exact base holder instrument 0x7bfa7c4f149e7415b73bdedfe609237e29cbf34a is an operational ERC-4626 protocol-position claim. USDC-denominated Morpho lending claims on Base, concentrated in a cbBTC-collateralized market; the lender vault does not directly hold the borrowers' cbBTC collateral. Verified deployment code and native accounting distinguish this receipt from direct parent fiat ownership and from Spark Savings V2.

pegMechanism: Deposit USDC to mint ERC-4626 lending-vault shares. Accrued lending interest increases USDC per share; redemption burns shares and withdraws available underlying liquidity from Morpho positions. Borrower defaults, collateral liquidation and vault fees affect share value.
